原文: If you modify a copy of the Library... you may convey a copy of the modified version: a) under this License... b) under the GNU GPL... You may convey a Combined Work under terms of your choice...

解释: 许可证明确授予非独占、全球范围、免版税的专利许可；但GPL/LGPL没有类似Apache许可证的专利反诉自动终止机制。

原文: Sublicensing is not allowed; section 10 makes it unnecessary. ... under the GNU GPL, with none of the additional permissions of this License applicable to that copy. ... You may convey a Combined Work under terms of your choice...

LGPL/GPL没有像Apache许可证那样要求保留和传递专门NOTICE文件的内容，因此该维度不适用。
